{{Quote|I bet even ''Biggs'' never made a one-handed shot with an ''energy-rifle--'' while fighting a ''landspeeder's'' controls!|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 17">[[Star Wars (1977) 17|''Star Wars'' (1977) 17]]</ref>}}
The '''6-2Aug2 hunting rifle''' was a [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]] produced by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]] and used during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], commonly on backwater worlds in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

[[File:CCG_ANH_6-2Aug2.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A Czerka 6-2Aug2 hunting rifle]]

The 6-2Aug2 had an elongated barrel that allowed for precise, long-range shooting, making up for the lack of a laser targeting sight or scope. The 6-2Aug2 was known to be easy to repair and maintain. It was quite similar to the Tusken [[Cycler rifle]] although more modern and with a faster rate of fire.

[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] owned a 6-2Aug2 during his youth on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="NEGWT" /> His [[Owen Lars/Legends|uncle]] started teaching him to use it when he was only seven [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old, the same age Owen started. Luke often used [[Womp rat/Legends|womp rats]] as target practice; by the time he was seventeen, he could shoot them from the driver's seat of his [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] without stopping to aim. The rifle was destroyed during a fight with the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] [[URoRRuR'R'R]] in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] prior to the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction of Alderaan]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Star Wars (1977)|Marvel Star Wars Comics]] Luke's 6-2Aug2 was referred to as a "laser rifle" or "energy-rifle". Later sources identified it as a slugthrower.
